name: Get Well
overview: Scripture reveals that true healing and strength come from the Lord, who blesses, keeps, and empowers those who are weak or faint. A joyful heart is likened to medicine, promoting well-being, while God’s presence brings peace that surpasses worldly comfort, removing fear and distress. Believers are assured of God's sustaining power and righteous help, encouraging trust in Him for both physical and spiritual restoration.
